title: Structure and asymptotic preserving deep neural surrogates for uncertainty quantification in multiscale kinetic equations
abstract: arXiv:2506.10636v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The high dimensionality of kinetic equations with stochastic parameters poses major computational challenges for uncertainty quantification (UQ). Traditional Monte Carlo (MC) sampling methods, while widely used, suffer from slow convergence and high variance, which become increasingly severe as the dimensionality of the parameter space grows. To accelerate MC sampling, we adopt a multiscale control variates strategy that leverages low-fidelity solutions from simplified kinetic models to reduce variance. To further improve sampling efficiency and preserve the underlying physics, we introduce surrogate models based on structure and asymptotic preserving neural networks (SAPNNs). These deep neural networks are specifically designed to satisfy key physical properties, including positivity, conservation laws, entropy dissipation, and asymptotic limits. translated_title: 面向多尺度动理学方程不确定性量化的结构与渐近保持深度神经网络代理模型
translated_abstract: 具有随机参数的动理学方程的高维性给不确定性量化带来了巨大的计算挑战。传统的蒙特卡洛（MC）采样方法虽然应用广泛，但收敛速度慢、方差高，且随着参数空间维数的增长，这些问题愈发严重。为了加速蒙特卡洛采样，我们采用了多尺度控制变量策略，利用简化动理学模型的低保真度解来降低方差。为了进一步提高采样效率并保持底层物理特性，我们引入了基于结构与渐近保持神经网络（SAPNNs）的代理模型。这些深度神经网络经过专门设计，以满足关键物理性质，包括正性、守恒律、熵耗散和渐近极限。通过在低保真度模型上训练SAPNNs，并用选定的高保真度样本对其进行丰富……
tldr: 该论文提出了结构与渐近保持神经网络（SAPNNs）作为深度学习代理模型，并结合多尺度控制变量策略，以加速蒙特卡洛采样，在保持正性、守恒律、熵耗散和渐近极限等关键物理性质的同时，实现对多尺度随机动理学方程的高效不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes structure and asymptotic preserving neural networks (SAPNNs) as deep learning surrogates, combined with a multiscale control variates strategy, to accelerate Monte Carlo sampling and enable efficient uncertainty quantification for multiscale kinetic equations while preserving key physical properties such as positivity, conservation laws, entropy dissipation, and asymptotic limits.
